findings: The four clipping planes partition the old triangle before drawing the recess; intact skin is not left across the opening.
Every floor vertex uses the same affine XY contraction and constant Z subtraction. Adjacent clipped triangles therefore retain coincident shared floor edges.
Only edges lying on the four actual opening planes receive walls; interior original triangle edges receive no extra walls.
The luminous patch lies above the closed floor by .04 local units; its joint is the average of a convex polygon on that exact plane, not an instance-centre estimate.
Nonblocking relief never adds luminous faces/joints. The new profile is explicit; the old pleated-sheet path keeps its quad and original marker branch.
evidence: Separate geometry checks supplied by the owner cover 1194 old meshes, 9 local variants and 4647 body points. This record is an independent source review; it does not repeat those runs.
limitations: No world visual or gameplay approval is assigned.
No new full-map generation, rendering or browser execution performed for this review.
